metadata.name: solana_ekza_arena
metadata.description: Anchor registry for Ekza Arena card assets published from Solana Stellar releases

instructions.name: commit_mint
docs: Commit-reveal mint — step 1: lock a future slot + charge the fee (§12.1).

accounts.name: treasury
docs: `registry.treasury` (enforced in the handler).

instructions.name: configure_registry
docs: Set the treasury + commit fee for the commit-reveal mint (spec §12.1).

instructions.name: create_player_avatar
docs: Create the player's character (one `PlayerAvatar` per wallet).

accounts.name: avatar_asset
docs: The Avatar card this character is based on (kind checked in the handler).

instructions.name: customize_avatar
docs: Rename / reskin the character, or swap its base Avatar card.

accounts.name: new_avatar_asset
docs: Optional replacement Avatar card (kind checked in the handler).

instructions.name: equip_item
docs: Equip an owned item NFT into the slot implied by its base type.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The NFT mint bound to this item.

accounts.name: token_account
docs: Owner's token account — must hold exactly the 1 NFT token.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The new NFT mint (1 token, 0 decimals). Mint+freeze authority start on the
payer; the Master Edition CPI then takes them over.

accounts.name: arena_item
docs: Game stats PDA, seeded by the NFT mint (spec §11.2).

accounts.name: minter_token_account
docs: Minter's associated token account — receives the single NFT token.

instructions.name: reveal_mint
docs: Commit-reveal mint — step 2: roll from the slot hash + mint (§12.1).
`nonce` re-derives the `MintCommit` PDA.

accounts.name: mint_commit
docs: The pending commit; closed here, rent returns to the minter.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The new NFT mint (1 token, 0 decimals).

accounts.name: arena_item
docs: Game stats PDA, seeded by the NFT mint (spec §11.2).

accounts.name: minter_token_account
docs: Minter's associated token account — receives the single NFT token.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The NFT mint bound to this item.

accounts.name: token_account
docs: Owner's token account — must hold exactly the 1 NFT token.

instructions.name: unequip_item
docs: Clear one equip slot (`slot` = ArenaBaseType slot index 0..3).

errors.name: InvalidMetadataLength
errors.msg: Invalid metadata URI or IPFS hash length.

errors.name: InvalidStats
errors.msg: Invalid Arena stats for this card kind.

errors.name: MissingStellarSkinAccounts
errors.msg: A Stellar skin was requested but the Stellar accounts were not supplied.

errors.name: NotNftHolder
errors.msg: The signer is not the current holder of the item NFT.

errors.name: RevealTooEarly
errors.msg: Reveal attempted before the committed target slot has passed.

errors.name: SlotHashNotFound
errors.msg: The committed target slot's hash is no longer in the SlotHashes sysvar.

errors.name: RegistryNotConfigured
errors.msg: The registry has not been configured with a treasury / commit fee.

errors.name: InvalidTreasury
errors.msg: The supplied treasury account does not match the configured treasury.

errors.name: InvalidAvatarAsset
errors.msg: The referenced arena asset is not an Avatar card.

errors.name: InvalidAvatarName
errors.msg: Invalid avatar name (empty or too long).

errors.name: InvalidEquipSlot
errors.msg: The avatar does not support this equip slot.

fields.name: skin_ref
docs: Cosmetic skin source (spec §2/§8b). Stellar-bridged assets store
`StellarAsset(<asset pubkey>)`; direct/manual cards default to a builtin.

fields.name: minter
docs: Original creator of the item. NOT the owner — ownership is the current
holder of the `mint` NFT token (spec §11.2). Gameplay reads must resolve
the owner from the token holder, never from `minter`.

fields.name: mint
docs: The SPL mint of the tradeable NFT this item is bound to (1:1). The PDA is
seeded by this mint (spec §11.2).

fields.name: enhance_level
docs: Forward-compat (spec §12.3): sharpening level. Defaulted 0 at mint; no
instruction mutates it yet (v5 `sharpen_item`).

fields.name: sockets
docs: Forward-compat (spec §12.3): gem sockets. Defaulted empty at mint, space
reserved for MAX_SOCKETS; no instruction mutates it yet (v5 `socket_gem`).

fields.name: treasury
docs: Destination of the non-refundable commit fee (spec §12.1). Set by
`configure_registry`; default (all-zero) until configured.

fields.name: commit_fee_lamports
docs: Non-refundable fee charged at `commit_mint`, in lamports (spec §12.1).

types.name: CommitMintArgs
docs: Args for `commit_mint` (spec §12.1). The roll is NOT performed here — only
the intent + future-slot lock is persisted; `reveal_mint` rolls from the
then-unknown slot hash.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Caller-chosen nonce, part of the `MintCommit` PDA seeds (lets one minter
have many concurrent commits).

types.name: ConfigureRegistryArgs
docs: Args for `configure_registry` — set the treasury + commit fee (spec §12.1).

types.name: CustomizeAvatarArgs
docs: Args for `customize_avatar`. All fields optional — only supplied parts
change. Passing a new `avatar_asset` account (see context) swaps the base
character and clears all equipped slots.

fields.name: skin
docs: Cosmetic skin override. Only `Builtin`/`Ipfs` are accepted here (Stellar
skins enter via the avatar card's own `skin_ref`).

types.name: ItemSkin
docs: Skin source — purely cosmetic, carries zero balance impact (spec §2).

fields.name: name
docs: NFT Metadata `name` (e.g. "Ekza Arena Item #12"). Client builds it.

fields.name: symbol
docs: NFT Metadata `symbol` (e.g. "EKZAITEM").

fields.name: uri
docs: Off-chain metadata JSON URI (skin image/animation + stats mirror, spec
§11.2). Client uploads to IPFS and passes the gateway/ipfs URI.

types.name: MintCommit
docs: A pending mint, committed to a FUTURE slot (spec §12.1). `reveal_mint` reads
the hash of `target_slot` (unknown at commit time) to derive the seed, making
the roll unpredictable and thus revert-grind resistant.

fields.name: target_slot
docs: Slot whose hash seeds the roll; reveal must wait until `Clock::slot` has
passed it AND the hash is still in the SlotHashes sysvar (~512 slots).

types.name: MintSkinArg
docs: Requested skin source for a minted item (cosmetic only, spec §2).

fields.name: avatar_asset
docs: The `ArenaAssetData` Avatar card this character is based on.

fields.name: name
docs: Player-chosen display name (cosmetic only).

fields.name: skin_ref
docs: Cosmetic skin override; defaults to the avatar card's `skin_ref`.

fields.name: slot_mask
docs: Copy of the avatar card's `slot_mask` at create/swap time — which equip
slots this character supports (bit N = `ArenaBaseType::slot_index()` N).

fields.name: equipped
docs: Equipped item NFT mints, indexed by `ArenaBaseType::slot_index()`.

types.name: RegisterArenaAssetFromStellarArgs
docs: Skin-only args for `register_arena_asset_from_stellar` (spec §2/§7/§8b).
A Stellar publish enters Arena as a SKIN ONLY — it carries zero balance.
Deliberately drops `base_stats/stat_delta/rarity/element` so the Stellar
caller cannot inject stats; balance comes from a later `mint_arena_item`
roll. Only the cosmetic/identity fields cross the bridge.

types.name: Socket
docs: Forward-compat gem socket (spec §12.3/§4 of rng-economy-upgrades). Reserved
now (defaulted empty at mint); the `socket_gem` instruction lands in v5.
